intent.caption: Orbit product hero — A machined-metal product body on a low plinth, slow orbital presentation, key+rim lighting, accent signal light.

visualSpec.effects: Watch mesh (/prism-mock/orrery/meshes/watch.glb) normalized to 2.2 scene units tall, centered at origin, resting on a low cylindrical plinth radius 1.4, height 0.25 units, top face at y=-1.1. Watch material: brushed-metal PBR roughness 0.52, metalness 0.55, clearcoat 0.2, clearcoatRoughness 0.4, anisotropy 0.8 aligned to case tangent. Plinth: roughness 0.7, metalness 0.3, near-black #14141a with engineered vertical gradient stops 0.0 #0b0b10 to 1.0 #16161d on the backdrop plane (7x6 units at z=-2.5). Contact shadow: radial-gradient plane radius 1.6 units under plinth, opacity 0.55. Orbit primitive on load: group rotates about y at 0.15 rad/s, camera-relative radius 0.6. Hover depth-rotate: tilt up to 6 deg toward cursor over 300ms cubic-bezier(0.215,0.61,0.355,1), release settles with weighted overshoot scale 1.04 to 1.0 over 900ms cubic-bezier(0.165,0.84,0.44,1). Headline baseline sits 1.5 units (6x base 0.25) below scene center; caption 0.5 units (2x base) below headline. Accent rim light grazes the left case flank so the bezel edge carries a #ff2a38 highlight; no bloom, glow discipline capped at emissive intensity 1.6.

sceneSpec.motionNote: Watch body orbits slowly about its y-axis (0.15 rad/s); on hover the whole group tilts up to 6 deg toward the cursor and settles with weighted 1.04 overshoot.
